messages:
elaine-partnerships: Quick flag: MI300 in eu-central tripped OOMs during long-context evals (rebel-13b v3 at seq=8192). Looks like KV-cache growth. Need a short mitigation (marketplace SKU fallback + SI test window + comms) before next Wed demos.

ken-eng: Can you drop the minimal repro and error text?

elaine-partnerships: Repro: `rebel-13b@v3`, seq_len=8192, batch=2, instance mi300-eu-04. Log: 'GPU OOM during KV-append at step 412'.

sam-platform: Proposed immediate steps: 1) routing policy `mi300-eu-fallback` (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%) routing rebel-13b to H100/H200 hosts; 2) non-breaking marketplace listing update to surface fallback SKUs for EU; 3) SI integration window for vendors to run RC tests.

jules-cloud: Marketplace draft mapping I can hold until SI window confirmed:
rebel-13b: eu -> [H100-XL, H200-STD]
I'll prepare the PR.

vendor-mi300: Acknowledged. We can reproduce and will have an RC driver build in ~72h. Short-term suggestion: set `gpu_mem_guard=0.85` and avoid quantized variants for the canary. RC will be binary-only for SI tests.

vendor-gaudi: We'll run extended seq stress on Gaudi if you share the commit/tag. No regression seen yet on our side; can produce a 24h parity report.

ken-eng: Also plan a runtime soft-fallback: if seq_len > 4096 prefer H100-compatible kernels for rebel-13b model-id. Toggle via config for fast rollback. Need perf/cost delta vs H100 for comms.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-900 created: "MI300 EU KV-cache growth / OOM". Runbook link (internal) attached.

sam-platform: I'll open the routing PR and attach marketplace draft + canary steps.

elaine-partnerships: Action owners: @sam-platform routing & listing PR, @ken-eng runtime toggle & perf eval, @jules-cloud SI window + marketplace timing, vendors to deliver RC + test reports. Reconvene in 48h or when RC lands. :thumbsup:
